dhpak1.13:3.1: Devadattassa vatthu pabbajitakālato paṭṭhāya yāva pathavippavesanā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhāsitāni sabbāni jātakāni vitthāretvā kathitaṃ.
dhpak1.13:3.2: Ayaṃ panettha saṅkhepo – satthari anupiyaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo atthi.
dhpak1.13:4.1: Ayaṃ panettha saṅkhepo – satthari anupiyaṃ nāma mallānaṃ nigamo atthi.
dhpak1.13:5.1: Taṃ nissāya anupiyambavane viharanteyeva tathāgatassa lakkhaṇapaṭiggahaṇadivaseyeva
dhpak1.13:5.3: buddho vā, khattiyaparivārova vicarissatī ” ti asītisahassaputtā
dhpak1.13:5.4: paṭiññātā. Tesu yebhuyyena pabbajitesu bhaddiyaṃ nāma rājānaṃ,
dhpak1.13:5.5: anuruddhaṃ, ānandaṃ, bhaguṃ, kimilaṃ, devadattanti ime cha sakye apabbajante disvā,“ mayaṃ attano putte pabbājema,
dhpak1.13:5.6: ime cha sakyā na ñātakā maññe, kasmā na pabbajantī ”
dhpak1.13:5.7: ti? Kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpesuṃ. Atha kho mahānāmo sakyo anuruddhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“ tāta,
dhpak1.13:5.8: amhākaṃ kulā pabbajito natthi, tvaṃ vā pabbaja, ahaṃ vā pabbajissāmī ” ti āha.
dhpak1.13:6.1: So pana sukhumālo hoti sampannabhogo,“ natthī ” ti vacanampi tena na sutapubbaṃ. Ekadivasañhi tesu chasu khattiyesu
dhpak1.13:6.2: guḷakīḷaṃ kīḷantesu anuruddho pūvena parājito pūvatthāya pahiṇi, athassa
dhpak1.13:6.3: mātā pūve sajjetvā pahiṇi. Te khāditvā puna kīḷiṃsu.
dhpak1.13:7.1: Punappunaṃ tasseva parājayo hoti. Mātā panassa pahite pahite tikkhattuṃ
dhpak1.13:7.2: pūve pahiṇitvā catutthavāre “ pūvā natthī ” ti pahiṇi.
dhpak1.13:7.3: So “ natthī ” ti vacanassa asukapubbattā “ esāpekā pūvavikati
dhpak1.13:7.4: bhavissatī ” ti maññamāno “ natthipūvaṃ me āharathā ” ti pesesi.
dhpak1.13:7.5: Mātā panassa “ natthipūvaṃ kira, ayye, dethā ” ti vutte,“ mama puttena ‘ natthī ’ ti padaṃ na sutapubbaṃ,
dhpak1.13:7.6: iminā pana upāyena naṃ etamatthaṃ jānāpessāmī ” ti tucchaṃ suvaṇṇapātiṃ aññāya suvaṇṇapātiyā paṭikujjitvā pesesi.
dhpak1.13:8.1: Nagarapariggāhikā devatā cintesuṃ – “ anuruddhasakyena annabhārakāle attano bhāgabhattaṃ upariṭṭhapaccekabuddhassa datvā
dhpak1.13:8.2: “‘ natthī ’ ti me vacanassa savanaṃ mā hotu, bhojanuppattiṭṭhānajānanaṃ
dhpak1.13:8.3: mā ‘ hotū ’ ti patthanā katā, sacāyaṃ tucchapātiṃ passissati,
dhpak1.13:8.4: devasamāgamaṃ pavisituṃ na labhissāma, sīsampi no sattadhā phaleyyā ” ti. Atha naṃ pātiṃ dibbapūvehi puṇṇaṃ akaṃsu.
dhpak1.13:8.5: Kassā guḷamaṇḍale ṭhapetvā ugghāṭitamattāya pūvagandho sakalanagare chādetvā ṭhito. Pūvakhaṇḍaṃ mukhe ṭhapitamattameva
dhpak1.13:9.1: So cintesi – “ nāhaṃ mātu piyo, ettakaṃ me kālaṃ imaṃ natthipūvaṃ
dhpak1.13:9.2: nāma na paci, ito paṭṭhāya aññaṃ pūvaṃ nāma na khādissāmī ” ti,
dhpak1.13:9.3: so gehaṃ gantvāva mātaraṃ pucchi – “ amma, tumhākaṃ ahaṃ piyo, appiyo ” ti? “ Tāta, ekakkhino akkhi viya ca hadayaṃ viya
dhpak1.13:9.4: ca ativiya piyo me ahosī ” ti. “ Atha kasmā ettakaṃ kālaṃ
dhpak1.13:9.5: mayhaṃ natthi pūvaṃ na pacittha, ammā ” ti? Sā cūḷūpaṭṭhākaṃ pucchi –
dhpak1.13:9.6: “ atthi kiñci pātiyaṃ, tātā ” ti? “ Paripuṇṇā, ayye, pāti pūvehi, evarūpā pūvā nāma me na diṭṭhapubbā ” ti ārocesi.
dhpak1.13:10.1: Sā cintesi – “ mayhaṃ putto puññavā katābhinīhāro
dhpak1.13:10.2: bhavissati, devatāhi pātiṃ pūretvā pūvā pahitā bhavissantī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:10.3: “ Atha naṃ putto, amma, ito paṭṭhāyāhaṃ aññaṃ pūvaṃ nāma na khādissāmi, natthipūvameva paceyyāsī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:10.5: ti vutte tucchapātimeva aññāya pātiyā paṭikucchitvā pesesi.
dhpak1.13:10.6: Yāva agāramajjhe vasi, tāvassa devatāva pūve pahiṇiṃsu.
dhpak1.13:11.1: So ettakampi ajānanto pabbajjaṃ nāma kiṃ jānissati? Tasmā “ kā esā pabbajjā nāmā ” ti bhātaraṃ pucchitvā “ ohāritakesamassunā
dhpak1.13:11.2: kāsāyanivatthena kaṭṭhattharake vā bidalamañcake vā nipajjitvā piṇḍāya carantena
dhpak1.13:11.3: viharitabbaṃ. Esā pabbajjā nāmā ” ti vutte,“ bhātika,
dhpak1.13:11.4: ahaṃ sukhumālo. Nāhaṃ sakkhissāmi pabbajitun ” ti āha. “ Tena hi, tāta, kammantaṃ uggahetvā gharāvāsaṃ vasa.
dhpak1.13:11.5: Na hi sakkā amhesu ekena apabbajitun ” ti. Atha naṃ “ ko esa kammanto nāmā ” ti pucchi.
dhpak1.13:12.1: “ Bhattuṭṭhānaṭṭhānampi ajānanto kulaputto kammantaṃ nāma kiṃ jānissatī ” ti? Ekadivasañhi tiṇṇaṃ khattiyānaṃ kathā udapādi –
dhpak1.13:12.2: “ bhattaṃ nāma kuhiṃ uṭṭhahatī ” ti? Kimilo āha – “ koṭṭhe uṭṭhahatī ” ti. Atha naṃ bhaddiyo “ tvaṃ bhattassa uṭṭhānaṭṭhānaṃ na jānāsi,
dhpak1.13:12.3: bhattaṃ nāma ukkhaliyaṃ uṭṭhahatī ” ti āha. Anuruddho “ tumhe dvepi na jānātha, bhattaṃ nāma ratanamakuḷāya suvaṇṇapātiyaṃ
dhpak1.13:13.1: Tesu kira ekadivasaṃ kimilo koṭṭhato vīhī otāriyamāne disvā,“ ete koṭṭheyeva jātā ” ti saññī ahosi.
dhpak1.13:13.2: Bhaddiyo ekadivasaṃ ukkhalito bhattaṃ vaḍḍhiyamānaṃ disvā “ ukkhaliyaññeva uppannan ” ti saññī ahosi.
dhpak1.13:13.3: Anuruddhena pana neva vīhī koṭṭentā, na bhattaṃ pacantā,
dhpak1.13:13.4: na vaḍḍhentā diṭṭhapubbā, vaḍḍhetvā pana purato ṭhapitameva passati.
dhpak1.13:13.6: ti saññamakāsi. Evaṃ tayopi te bhattuṭṭhānaṭṭhānaṃ na jānanti.
dhpak1.13:14.1: Tenāyaṃ “ ko esa kammanto nāmā ” ti
dhpak1.13:14.2: pucchitvā,“ paṭhamaṃ khettaṃ kasāpetabban ” tiādikaṃ saṃvacchare saṃvacchare kattabbaṃ
dhpak1.13:14.3: kiccaṃ sutvā,“ kadā kammantānaṃ anto paññāyissati, kadā mayaṃ appossukkā bhoge bhuñjissāmā ” ti vatvā kammantānaṃ
dhpak1.13:14.4: apariyantatāya akkhātāya “ tena hi tvaññeva gharāvāsaṃ vasa,
dhpak1.13:14.5: na mayhaṃ etenattho ” ti mātaraṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“ anujānāhi maṃ,
dhpak1.13:15.1: tāya nānappakārehi tikkhattuṃ paṭikkhipitvā,“ sace te sahāyako bhaddiyarājā pabbajissati, tena saddhiṃ pabbajāhī ” ti
dhpak1.13:15.2: vutte taṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“ mama kho, samma, pabbajjā tava
dhpak1.13:15.3: paṭibaddhā ” ti vatvā taṃ nānappakārehi saññāpetvā sattame divase
dhpak1.13:16.1: Tato bhaddiyo sakyarājā anuruddho ānando bhagu kimilo
dhpak1.13:16.2: devadattoti ime cha khattiyā upālikappakasattamā devā viya dibbasampattiṃ
dhpak1.13:16.3: sattāhaṃ sampattiṃ anubhavitvā uyyānaṃ gacchantā viya
dhpak1.13:16.4: caturaṅginiyā senāya nikkhamitvā paravisayaṃ patvā rājāṇāya senaṃ
dhpak1.13:16.5: nivattāpetvā paravisayaṃ okkamiṃsu. Tattha cha khattiyā attano
dhpak1.13:16.6: attano ābharaṇāni omuñcitvā bhaṇḍikaṃ katvā,“ handa bhaṇe,
dhpak1.13:16.7: upāli, nivattassu, alaṃ te ettakaṃ jīvikāyā ” ti tassa adaṃsu. So tesaṃ pādamūle parivattitvā paridevitvā tesaṃ āṇaṃ
dhpak1.13:16.8: atikkamituṃ asakkonto uṭṭhāya taṃ gahetvā nivatti. Tesaṃ
dhpak1.13:16.9: dvidhā jātakāle, vanaṃ ārodanappattaṃ viya pathavīkampamānākārappattā viya ahosi.
dhpak1.13:17.1: Upāli kappakopi thokaṃ gantvā nivattitvā “ caṇḍā kho sākiyā,‘ iminā kumārā nippātitā ’ ti ghāteyyumpi maṃ.
dhpak1.13:17.2: Ime hi nāma sakyakumārā evarūpaṃ sampattiṃ pahāya imāni anagghāni ābharaṇāni kheḷapiṇḍaṃ viya chaḍḍetvā pabbajissanti,
dhpak1.13:17.3: kimaṅgaṃ panāhan ” ti bhaṇḍikaṃ omuñcitvā tāni ābharaṇāni rukkhe
dhpak1.13:17.4: laggetvā “ atthikā gaṇhantū ” ti vatvā tesaṃ santikaṃ
dhpak1.13:17.5: gantvā tehi “ kasmā nivattosī ” ti puṭṭho tamatthaṃ ārocesi.
dhpak1.13:18.1: Atha naṃ te ādāya satthu santikaṃ gantvā,“ mayaṃ, bhante, sākiyā nāma mānanissitā, ayaṃ amhākaṃ dīgharattaṃ paricārako,
dhpak1.13:18.2: imaṃ paṭhamataraṃ pabbājetha, mayamassa abhivādanādīni karissāma, evaṃ
dhpak1.13:18.3: no māno nimmānāyissatī ” ti vatvā taṃ paṭhamataraṃ
dhpak1.13:19.1: Tesu āyasmā bhaddiyo teneva antaravassena tevijjo ahosi.
dhpak1.13:19.2: Āyasmā anuruddho dibbacakkhuko hutvā pacchā mahāvitakkasuttaṃ (a.
dhpak1.13:19.3: ni.8.30) sutvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi. Āyasmā ānando sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahi. Bhagutthero ca kimilatthero ca aparabhāge
dhpak1.13:19.4: vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu. Devadatto pothujjanikaṃ iddhiṃ patto.
dhpak1.13:20.1: Aparabhāge satthari kosambiyaṃ viharante sasāvakasaṅghassa tathāgatassa mahanto lābhasakkāro nibbatti.
dhpak1.13:20.3: kuhiṃ satthā, kuhiṃ sāriputtatthero, kuhiṃ mahāmoggallānatthero,
dhpak1.13:20.4: kuhiṃ mahākassapatthero, kuhiṃ bhaddiyatthero, kuhiṃ anuruddhatthero, kuhiṃ ānandatthero, kuhiṃ bhagutthero,
dhpak1.13:20.5: kuhiṃ kimilatthero ” ti asītimahāsāvakānaṃ nisinnaṭṭhānaṃ olokentā vicaranti.
dhpak1.13:22.1: “ Devadattatthero kuhiṃ nisinno vā, ṭhito vā ” ti pucchanto
dhpak1.13:22.2: nāma natthi. So cintesi – “ ahampi etehi saddhiññeva pabbajito,
dhpak1.13:22.3: etepi khattiyapabbajitā, ahampi khattiyapabbajito, lābhasakkārahatthā manussā
dhpak1.13:22.4: eteyeva pariyesanti, mama nāmaṃ gahetāpi natthi.
dhpak1.13:22.5: Kena nu kho saddhiṃ ekato hutvā kaṃ pasādetvā mama lābhasakkāraṃ nibbatteyyan ” ti.
dhpak1.13:23.1: Athassa etadahosi – “ ayaṃ kho rājā bimbisāro paṭhamadassaneneva ekādasahi nahutehi saddhiṃ sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhito,
dhpak1.13:23.2: na sakkā etena saddhiṃ ekato bhavituṃ, kosalaraññāpi saddhiṃ na
dhpak1.13:23.3: sakkā bhavituṃ. Ayaṃ kho pana rañño putto ajātasattu kumāro
dhpak1.13:23.4: kassaci guṇadose na jānāti, etena saddhiṃ ekato bhavissāmī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:24.1: So kosambito rājagahaṃ gantvā kumārakavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā
dhpak1.13:24.2: cattāro āsīvise catūsu hatthapādesu ekaṃ gīvāya pilandhitvā
dhpak1.13:24.3: ekaṃ sīse cumbaṭakaṃ katvā ekaṃ ekaṃsaṃ karitvā
dhpak1.13:24.4: imāya ahimekhalāya ākāsato oruyha ajātasattussa ucchaṅge nisīditvā tena
dhpak1.13:24.5: bhītena “ kosi tvan ” ti vutte “ ahaṃ devadatto ” ti vatvā tassa bhayavinodanatthaṃ taṃ attabhāvaṃ paṭisaṃharitvā
dhpak1.13:24.6: saṅghāṭipattacīvaradharo purato ṭhatvā taṃ pasādetvā lābhasakkāraṃ nibbattesi.
dhpak1.13:26.1: satthāraṃ veḷuvanavihāre sarājikāya parisāya dhammaṃ desentaṃ vanditvā
dhpak1.13:27.2: imaṃ paṭhamaṃ tathāgate āghātaṃ bandhitvā pakkāmi.
dhpak1.13:28.1: So “ pariccatto dāni ahaṃ samaṇena gotamena, idānissa
dhpak1.13:28.2: anatthaṃ karissāmī ” ti ajātasattuṃ upasaṅkamitvā,“ pubbe kho,
dhpak1.13:28.3: kumāra, manussā dīghāyukā, etarahi appāyukā. Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ vijjati, yaṃ tvaṃ kumārova samāno kālaṃ kareyyāsi,
dhpak1.13:28.4: tena hi tvaṃ, kumāra, pitaraṃ hantvā rājā hohi, ahaṃ
dhpak1.13:28.5: bhagavantaṃ hantvā buddho bhavissāmī ” ti vatvā tasmiṃ rajje patiṭṭhite
dhpak1.13:28.6: tathāgatassa vadhāya purise payojetvā tesu sotāpattiphalaṃ patvā nivattesu
dhpak1.13:29.1: sayaṃ gijjhakūṭapabbataṃ abhiruhitvā,“ ahameva samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ
dhpak1.13:29.2: jīvitā voropessāmī ” ti silaṃ pavijjhitvā ruhiruppādakakammaṃ
dhpak1.13:29.3: katvā imināpi upāyena māretuṃ asakkonto puna nāḷāgiriṃ
dhpak1.13:29.4: vissajjāpesi. Tasmiṃ āgacchante ānandatthero attano jīvitaṃ satthu
dhpak1.13:30.1: Satthā nāgaṃ dametvā nagarā nikkhamitvā vihāraṃ gantvā anekasahassehi upāsakehi abhihaṭaṃ mahādānaṃ paribhuñjitvā tasmiṃ
dhpak1.13:30.2: divase sannipatitānaṃ aṭṭhārasakoṭisaṅkhātānaṃ rājagahavāsīnaṃ anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathetvā caturāsītiyā pāṇasahassānaṃ
dhpak1.13:30.3: dhammābhisamaye jāte “ aho āyasmā ānando mahāguṇo,
dhpak1.13:30.4: tathārūpe nāma hatthināge āgacchante attano jīvitaṃ pariccajitvā satthu
dhpak1.13:30.5: puratova aṭṭhāsī ” ti therassa guṇakathaṃ sutvā “ na, bhikkhave, idāneva, pubbepesa mamatthāya jīvitaṃ pariccajiyevā ” ti
dhpak1.13:30.6: vatvā bhikkhūhi yācito cūḷahaṃsa (jā.1.15.133 ādayo;2.21.1 ādayo)–
dhpak1.13:31.1: Devadattassāpi kammaṃ neva pākaṭaṃ, tathā rañño mārāpitattā, na vadhakānaṃ payojitattā na silāya paviddhattā pākaṭaṃ ahosi,
dhpak1.13:31.2: yathā nāḷāgirihatthino vissajjitattā. Tadā hi mahājano “
dhpak1.13:31.3: rājāpi devadatteneva mārāpito, vadhakopi payojito, silāpi apaviddhā.
dhpak1.13:31.4: Idāni pana tena nāḷāgiri vissajjāpito, evarūpaṃ nāma pāpakaṃ gahetvā rājā vicaratī ” ti kolāhalamakāsi.
dhpak1.13:31.5: Rājā mahājanassa kathaṃ sutvā pañca thālipākasatāni nīharāpetvā
dhpak1.13:31.6: na puna tassūpaṭṭhānaṃ agamāsi, nāgarāpissa kulaṃ upagatassa
dhpak1.13:32.1: So parihīnalābhasakkāro kohaññena jīvitukāmo satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā
dhpak1.13:32.2: pañca vatthūni yācitvā bhagavato “ alaṃ, devadatta,
dhpak1.13:32.3: yo icchati, so āraññako hotū ” ti
dhpak1.13:32.4: paṭikkhitto kassāvuso, vacanaṃ sobhanaṃ, kiṃ tathāgatassa udāhu mama,
dhpak1.13:32.5: ahañhi ukkaṭṭhavasena evaṃ vadāmi,“ sādhu, bhante,
dhpak1.13:32.6: bhikkhū yāvajīvaṃ āraññakā assu, piṇḍapātikā, paṃsukūlikā, rukkhamūlikā,
dhpak1.13:32.7: macchamaṃsaṃ na khādeyyun ” ti. “ Yo dukkhā muccitukāmo, so mayā saddhiṃ āgacchatū ” ti vatvā pakkāmi.
dhpak1.13:33.1: Tassa vacanaṃ sutvā ekacce navakapabbajitā mandabuddhino “ kalyāṇaṃ devadatto
dhpak1.13:33.2: āha, etena saddhiṃ vicarissāmā ” ti tena saddhiṃ ekato ahesuṃ.
dhpak1.13:33.3: Iti so pañcasatehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ tehi pañcahi vatthūhi lūkhappasannaṃ janaṃ saññāpento kulesu viññāpetvā viññāpetvā
dhpak1.13:34.1: So bhagavatā,“ saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, devadatta, saṅghabhedāya parakkamasi cakkabhedāyā ”
dhpak1.13:34.2: ti puṭṭho “ saccaṃ bhagavā ” ti vatvā,“ garuko kho,
dhpak1.13:34.3: devadatta, saṅghabhedo ” tiādīhi ovaditopi satthu vacanaṃ anādiyitvā
dhpak1.13:35.1: pakkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ disvā,“ ajjatagge dānāhaṃ, āvuso ānanda, aññatreva bhagavatā, aññatra,
dhpak1.13:35.2: bhikkhusaṅghā uposathaṃ karissāmi, saṅghakammaṃ karissāmī ” ti āha. Thero tamatthaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
dhpak1.13:35.3: Taṃ viditvā satthā uppannadhammasaṃvego hutvā,“ devadatto
dhpak1.13:35.4: sadevakassa lokassa anatthanissitaṃ attano avīcimhi paccanakakammaṃ
dhpak1.13:36.1: “ Sukarāni asādhūni, attano ahitāni ca; Yaṃ ve hitañca sādhuñca, taṃ ve paramadukkaran ” ti.(dha. pa.163)–
dhpak1.13:37.1: Imaṃ gāthaṃ vatvā puna imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi –
dhpak1.13:38.1: “ Sukaraṃ sādhunā sādhu, sādhu pāpena dukkaraṃ;
dhpak1.13:38.2: Pāpaṃ pāpena sukaraṃ, pāpamariyehi dukkaran ” ti.(udā.48; cūḷava.343);
dhpak1.13:39.1: Atha kho devadatto uposathadivase attano parisāya saddhiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīditvā,“
dhpak1.13:39.2: yassimāni pañca vatthūni khamanti, so salākaṃ gaṇhatū ” ti vatvā
dhpak1.13:40.1: pañcasatehi vajjiputtakehi navakehi appakataññūhi salākāya gahitāya saṅghaṃ bhinditvā te bhikkhū ādāya gayāsīsaṃ agamāsi.
dhpak1.13:40.2: Tassa tattha gatabhāvaṃ sutvā satthā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ānayanatthāya dve aggasāvake pesesi.
dhpak1.13:40.3: Te tattha gantvā ādesanāpāṭihāriyānusāsaniyā ceva iddhipāṭihāriyānusāsaniyā ca
dhpak1.13:40.4: anusāsantā te amataṃ pāyetvā ādāya ākāsena āgamiṃsu.
dhpak1.13:41.1: Kokālikopi kho “ uṭṭhehi, āvuso devadatta, nītā te bhikkhū sāriputtamoggallānehi, nanu tvaṃ mayā vutto ‘ mā, āvuso,
dhpak1.13:41.2: sāriputtamoggallāne vissāsī ’ ti. Pāpicchā sāriputtamoggallānā, pāpikānaṃ icchānaṃ
dhpak1.13:41.3: vasaṃ gatā ” ti vatvā jaṇṇukena hadayamajjhe pahari,
dhpak1.13:41.4: tassa tattheva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggañchi.
dhpak1.13:42.1: Āyasmantaṃ pana sāriputtaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaparivutaṃ ākāsena āgacchantaṃ disvā bhikkhū āhaṃsu – “ bhante, āyasmā sāriputto
dhpak1.13:42.2: gamanakāle attadutiyo gato, idāni mahāparivāro āgacchanto sobhatī ”
dhpak1.13:42.3: ti. Satthā “ na, bhikkhave, idāneva sāriputto sobhati,
dhpak1.13:42.4: pubbe tiracchānayoniyaṃ nibbattakālepi mayhaṃ putto mama santikaṃ āgacchanto sobhiyevā ” ti vatvā –
dhpak1.13:43.1: Atīte magadharaṭṭhe rājagahanagare eko magadharājā rajjaṃ kāresi. Tadā bodhisatto migayoniyaṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā vuddhippatto
dhpak1.13:43.2: migasahassaparivāro araññe vasati. Tassa lakkhaṇo ca kāḷo cāti dve puttā ahesuṃ. So attano mahallakakāle “tātā,
dhpak1.13:43.3: ahaṃ idāni mahallako, tumhe imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharathā”ti pañca pañca migasatāni ekekaṃ puttaṃ paṭicchāpesi.
dhpak1.13:43.4: Tato paṭṭhāya te dve janā migagaṇaṃ pariharanti.
dhpak1.13:44.1: Magadharaṭṭhasmiñca sassapākasamaye kiṭṭhasambādhe araññe migānaṃ paripantho hoti. Manussā sassakhādakānaṃ migānaṃ
dhpak1.13:44.2: māraṇatthāya tattha tattha opātaṃ khaṇanti, sūlāni ropenti, pāsāṇayantāni sajjenti, kūṭapāsādayo pāse oḍḍenti,
dhpak1.13:45.1: Bodhisatto kiṭṭhasambādhasamayaṃ ñatvā dve putte pakkosāpetvā āha
dhpak1.13:45.2: – “tātā, ayaṃ kiṭṭhasambādhasamayo, bahū migā vināsaṃ pāpuṇanti,
dhpak1.13:45.3: mayaṃ mahallakā yena kenaci upāyena ekasmiṃ ṭhāne
dhpak1.13:45.4: vītināmessāma, tumhe tumhākaṃ migagaṇe gahetvā araññe pabbatapādaṃ
dhpak1.13:45.5: pavisitvā sassānaṃ uddhaṭakāle āgaccheyyāthā”ti. Te “sādhū”ti pitu vacanaṃ sutvā saparivārā nikkhamiṃsu.
dhpak1.13:46.1: Tesaṃ pana gamanamaggaṃ manussā jānanti “imasmiṃ kāle migā pabbatamārohanti, imasmiṃ kāle orohantī”ti.
dhpak1.13:46.2: Te tattha tattha paṭicchannaṭṭhāne nilīnā bahū mige vijjhitvā mārenti. Kāḷamigo attano dandhatāya “imāya nāma velāya gantabbaṃ,
dhpak1.13:46.3: imāya velāya na gantabba”nti ajānanto migagaṇaṃ ādāya pubbaṇhepi sāyanhepi padosepi paccūsepi gāmadvārena gacchati.
dhpak1.13:46.4: Manussā tattha tattha pakatiyā ṭhitā ca nilīnā ca bahū mige vināsaṃ pāpenti. Evaṃ so attano dandhatāya bahū mige vināsaṃ
dhpak1.13:47.1: Lakkhaṇamigo pana paṇḍito byatto upāyakusalo “imāya velāya gantabbaṃ, imāya velāya na gantabba”nti jānāti.
dhpak1.13:47.2: So gāmadvārenapi na gacchati, divāpi na gacchati, padosepi na gacchati, paccūsepi na gacchati, migagaṇaṃ ādāya aḍḍharattasamayeyeva gacchati.
dhpak1.13:47.3: Tasmā ekampi migaṃ avināsetvā araññaṃ pāvisi.
dhpak1.13:48.1: Te tattha cattāro māse vasitvā sassesu uddhaṭesu
dhpak1.13:48.2: pabbatā otariṃsu. Kāḷo paccāgacchantopi purimanayeneva avasesamige vināsaṃ
dhpak1.13:48.3: pāpento ekakova āgami. Lakkhaṇo pana ekamigampi avināsetvā pañcahi migasatehi parivuto mātāpitūnaṃ santikaṃ āgami.
dhpak1.13:48.4: Bodhisatto dvepi putte āgacchante disvā migagaṇena saddhiṃ mantento imaṃ gāthaṃ samuṭṭhāpesi –
dhpak1.13:50.1: Puna bhikkhūhi,“ bhante, devadatto kira dve aggasāvake ubhosu
dhpak1.13:50.2: passesu nisīdāpetvā ‘ buddhalīḷāya dhammaṃ desessāmī ’ ti
dhpak1.13:50.3: tumhākaṃ anukiriyaṃ karotī ” ti vutte,“ na, bhikkhave, idāneva, pubbepesa
dhpak1.13:50.4: mama anukiriyaṃ kātuṃ vāyami, na pana sakkhī ” ti vatvā –
dhpak1.13:51.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto himavantapadese udakakākayoniyaṃ nibbattitvā ekaṃ saraṃ upanissāya vasi, “vīrako”tissa nāmaṃ ahosi.
dhpak1.13:52.1: Tadā kāsiraṭṭhe dubbhikkhaṃ ahosi, manussā kākabhattaṃ vā dātuṃ yakkhanāgabalikammaṃ vā kātuṃ nāsakkhiṃsu.
dhpak1.13:53.1: Tattheko bārāṇasivāsī saviṭṭhako nāma kāko kākiṃ ādāya vīrakassa
dhpak1.13:53.2: vasanaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā taṃ saraṃ nissāya ekamante vāsaṃ kappesi.
dhpak1.13:54.1: So ekadivasaṃ tasmiṃ sare gocaraṃ gaṇhanto vīrakaṃ
dhpak1.13:54.2: saraṃ otaritvā macche khāditvā paccuttaritvā sarīraṃ sukkhāpentaṃ disvā
dhpak1.13:54.3: “imaṃ udakakākaṃ nissāya sakkā bahū macche laddhuṃ, imaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmī”ti taṃ upasaṅkamitvā
dhpak1.13:55.1: “kiṃ, sammā”ti vutte “icchāmi taṃ sāmi upaṭṭhahitu”nti vatvā “sādhū”ti tena sampaṭicchito tato paṭṭhāya upaṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.13:56.1: Vīrakopi tato paṭṭhāya attano yāpanamattaṃ khāditvā macche uddharitvā
dhpak1.13:57.1: Tassa aparabhāge māno uppajji – “ayampi udakakāko kāḷako, ahampi kāḷako, akkhituṇḍapādehipi etassa ca mayhañca nānākaraṇaṃ natthi,
dhpak1.13:57.2: ito paṭṭhāya iminā gahitamacchehi mayhaṃ kammaṃ natthi, ahameva gaṇhissāmī”ti. So vīrakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā “samma,
dhpak1.13:57.3: ito paṭṭhāya ahameva saraṃ otaritvā macche gaṇhissāmī”ti vatvā “na tvaṃ, samma, udakaṃ otaritvā macche gaṇhanakakule nibbatto,
dhpak1.13:58.1: tena vāriyamānopi vacanaṃ anādiyitvā saraṃ oruyha
dhpak1.13:58.2: udakaṃ pavisitvā ummujjamāno sevālaṃ chinditvā nikkhamituṃ nāsakkhi,
dhpak1.13:58.3: sevālantare laggi, aggatuṇḍameva paññāyi. So nirassāso antoudakeyeva jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpuṇi.
dhpak1.13:59.1: Athassa bhariyā āgamanaṃ apassamānā taṃ pavattiṃ jānanatthaṃ vīrakassa santikaṃ gantvā “sāmi, saviṭṭhako na paññāyati,
dhpak1.13:59.2: kahaṃ nu kho so”ti pucchamānā paṭhamaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.13:60.1: 107. “Api vīraka passesi, sakuṇaṃ mañjubhāṇakaṃ; Mayūragīvasaṅkāsaṃ, patiṃ mayhaṃ saviṭṭhaka”nti.
dhpak1.13:61.1: Taṃ sutvā vīrako “āma, jānāmi te sāmikassa gataṭṭhāna”nti vatvā dutiyaṃ gāthamāha – 108.
dhpak1.13:63.1: Ādinā jātakaṃ vatvā aparāparesupi divasesu tathānurūpameva kathaṃ ārabbha –
dhpak1.13:64.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto himavantapadese rukkhakoṭṭakasakuṇayoniyaṃ nibbatti,
dhpak1.13:64.2: “khadiravaniyo”tissa nāmaṃ ahosi. So khadiravaneyeva gocaraṃ gaṇhi, tasseko kandagalako nāma sahāyo ahosi,
dhpak1.13:65.1: So ekadivasaṃ khadiravaniyassa santikaṃ agamāsi. Khadiravaniyo “sahāyo me āgato”ti kandagalakaṃ gahetvā khadiravanaṃ
dhpak1.13:65.2: pavisitvā khadirakhandhaṃ tuṇḍena paharitvā rukkhato pāṇake nīharitvā adāsi. Kandagalako dinne dinne madhurapūve viya
dhpak1.13:65.3: chinditvā chinditvā khādi. Tassa khādantasseva māno uppajji – “ayampi rukkhakoṭṭakayoniyaṃ nibbatto, ahampi,
dhpak1.13:65.4: kiṃ me etena dinnagocarena, sayameva khadiravane gocaraṃ gaṇhissāmī”ti.
dhpak1.13:66.1: So khadiravaniyaṃ āha – “samma, mā tvaṃ dukkhaṃ anubhavi,
dhpak1.13:66.2: ahameva khadiravane gocaraṃ gaṇhissāmī”ti. Atha naṃ so “handa tvaṃ samma,
dhpak1.13:66.3: simbalipālibhaddakādivane nissāre gocaraggahaṇakule jāto, khadirā nāma jātasārā thaddhā, mā te etaṃ ruccī”ti āha.
dhpak1.13:67.1: Kandagalako “kiṃ dānāhaṃ na rukkhakoṭṭakayoniyaṃ nibbatto”ti tassa vacanaṃ anādiyitvā vegena gantvā khadirarukkhaṃ tuṇḍena pahari.
dhpak1.13:67.2: Tāvadevassa tuṇḍaṃ bhijji, akkhīni nikkhamanākārappattāni jātāni, sīsaṃ phalitaṃ. So khandhe patiṭṭhātuṃ asakkonto bhūmiyaṃ
dhpak1.13:68.1: 119. “Ambho ko nāmayaṃ rukkho, sinnapatto sakaṇṭako; Yattha ekappahārena, uttamaṅgaṃ vibhijjita”nti.
dhpak1.13:69.1: Taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā khadiravaniyo dutiyaṃ gāthamāha – 120.
dhpak1.13:72.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kesarasīho hutvā himavantappadese kañcanaguhāyaṃ vāsaṃ kappesi.
dhpak1.13:72.2: So ekadivasaṃ kañcanaguhāya nikkhamitvā vijambhitvā catuddisaṃ
dhpak1.13:72.3: oloketvā sīhanādaṃ naditvā gocarāya pakkanto mahāmahiṃsaṃ
dhpak1.13:72.4: vadhitvā varamaṃsaṃ khāditvā ekaṃ saraṃ otaritvā maṇivaṇṇassa udakassa kucchiṃ pūretvā guhaṃ sandhāya pāyāsi.
dhpak1.13:73.1: Atheko siṅgālo gocarappasuto sahasāva sīhaṃ disvā palāyituṃ asakkonto sīhassa purato pādesu patitvā nipajji.
dhpak1.13:73.2: “Kiṃ, jambukā”ti ca vutte “ahaṃ te, sāmi, pāde
dhpak1.13:73.3: upaṭṭhātukāmo”ti āha. Sīho “sādhu ehi, maṃ upaṭṭhaha, varamaṃsāni taṃ
dhpak1.13:73.4: khādāpessāmī”ti vatvā siṅgālaṃ ādāya kañcanaguhaṃ agamāsi.
dhpak1.13:74.1: Siṅgālo tato paṭṭhāya sīhavighāsaṃ khādati. So katipāhaccayeneva thūlasarīro ahosi. Atha naṃ ekadivasaṃ guhāya nipannakova
dhpak1.13:74.2: sīho āha “gaccha jambuka, pabbatasikhare ṭhatvā pabbatapāde sañcarantesu hatthiassamahiṃsādīsu yassa maṃsaṃ khāditukāmosi,
dhpak1.13:74.3: taṃ oloketvā āgantvā ‘asukamaṃsaṃ khāditukāmomhī’ti vatvā maṃ vanditvā ‘viroca, sāmī’ti vadāhi, ahaṃ taṃ vadhitvā
dhpak1.13:74.4: madhuramaṃsaṃ khāditvā tuyhampi dassāmī”ti. Siṅgālo pabbatasikharaṃ abhiruhitvā nānappakāre mige oloketvā yasseva maṃsaṃ
dhpak1.13:74.5: khāditukāmo hoti, kañcanaguhaṃ pavisitvā tameva sīhassa ārocetvā pādesu patitvā “viroca, sāmī”ti vadati.
dhpak1.13:74.6: Sīho vegena pakkhanditvā sacepi mattavaravāraṇo hoti, tattheva naṃ jīvitakkhayaṃ pāpetvā sayampi varamaṃsaṃ khādati,
dhpak1.13:74.7: siṅgālassapi deti. Siṅgālo kucchipūraṃ maṃsaṃ khāditvā guhaṃ pavisitvā niddāyati.
dhpak1.13:75.1: So gacchante gacchante kāle mānaṃ vaḍḍhesi “ahampi catuppadova, kiṃkāraṇā divase divase parehi posiyamāno viharāmi,
dhpak1.13:75.2: ito paṭṭhāya ahampi hatthiādayo hanitvā maṃsaṃ khādissāmi, sīhopi
dhpak1.13:75.3: migarājā ‘viroca, sāmī’ti vuttameva padaṃ nissāya varavāraṇe vadheti,
dhpak1.13:75.4: ahampi sīhena ‘viroca, jambukā’ti maṃ vadāpetvā ekaṃ varavāraṇaṃ vadhitvā maṃsaṃ khādissāmī”ti.
dhpak1.13:76.1: So sīhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca “sāmi, mayā dīgharattaṃ tumhehi vadhitavaravāraṇānaṃ maṃsaṃ khāditaṃ,
dhpak1.13:76.2: ahampi ekaṃ varavāraṇaṃ māretvā maṃsaṃ khāditukāmo, tasmā tumhehi nipannaṭṭhāne kañcanaguhāyaṃ nipajjissāmi,
dhpak1.13:76.3: tumhe pabbatapāde vicarantaṃ varavāraṇaṃ oloketvā mama santikaṃ
dhpak1.13:76.4: āgantvā ‘viroca, jambukā’ti vadetha, ettakamattasmiṃ maccheraṃ mā karitthā”ti.
dhpak1.13:77.1: Atha naṃ sīho āha “na, tvaṃ jambuka, vāraṇe vadhituṃ samatthe sīhakule uppanno, vāraṇaṃ vadhitvā maṃsaṃ khādanasamattho
dhpak1.13:77.2: siṅgālo nāma loke natthi, mā te etaṃ rucci, mayā
dhpak1.13:77.3: vadhitavaravāraṇānaññeva maṃsaṃ khāditvā vasā”ti. So evaṃ vuttepi viramituṃ na icchi,
dhpak1.13:77.4: punappunaṃ yāciyeva. Sīho taṃ vāretuṃ asakkonto sampaṭicchitvā “tena hi mama vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā nipajjā”ti jambukaṃ
dhpak1.13:77.5: kañcanaguhāyaṃ nipajjāpetvā sayaṃ pabbatapāde mattavaravāraṇaṃ oloketvā guhādvāraṃ gantvā “viroca, jambukā”ti āha.
dhpak1.13:77.6: Siṅgālo kañcanaguhāya nikkhamitvā vijambhitvā catuddisaṃ oloketvā tikkhattuṃ vassitvā “mattavaravāraṇassa kumbhe patissāmī”ti
dhpak1.13:77.7: pakkhanditvā virajjhitvā pādamūle pati. Vāraṇo dakkhiṇapādaṃ
dhpak1.13:77.8: ukkhipitvā tassa sīsaṃ akkami, sīsaṭṭhīni cuṇṇavicuṇṇāni ahesuṃ.
dhpak1.13:77.9: Athassa sarīraṃ vāraṇo pādena saṅgharitvā rāsiṃ katvā upari laṇḍaṃ pātetvā koñcanādaṃ nadanto araññaṃ pāvisi.
dhpak1.13:78.1: 143. “Lasī ca te nipphalitā, matthako ca padālito; Sabbā te phāsukā bhaggā, ajja kho tvaṃ virocasī”ti.
dhpak1.13:79.1: Puna “ akataññū devadatto ” ti kathaṃ ārabbha –
dhpak1.13:80.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto himavantapadese rukkhakoṭṭakasakuṇo hutvā nibbatti.
dhpak1.13:81.1: Athekassa sīhassa maṃsaṃ khādantassa aṭṭhi gale laggi, galo
dhpak1.13:81.2: uddhumāyi, gocaraṃ gaṇhituṃ na sakkoti, kharā vedanā pavattati.
dhpak1.13:81.3: Atha naṃ so sakuṇo gocarappasuto disvā sākhāya nilīno “kiṃ te, samma, dukkha”nti pucchi. So tamatthaṃ ācikkhi. “Ahaṃ te,
dhpak1.13:81.4: samma, etaṃ aṭṭhiṃ apaneyyaṃ, bhayena pana te mukhaṃ pavisituṃ na visahāmi, khādeyyāsipi ma”nti. “Mā bhāyi, samma,
dhpak1.13:81.5: nāhaṃ taṃ khādāmi, jīvitaṃ me dehī”ti.
dhpak1.13:82.1: So “sādhū”ti taṃ vāmapassena nipajjāpetvā “ko jānāti, kimpesa karissatī”ti cintetvā yathā mukhaṃ pidahituṃ na sakkoti,
dhpak1.13:82.2: tathā tassa adharoṭṭhe ca uttaroṭṭhe ca daṇḍakaṃ ṭhapetvā
dhpak1.13:82.3: mukhaṃ pavisitvā aṭṭhikoṭiṃ tuṇḍena pahari, aṭṭhi patitvā gataṃ.
dhpak1.13:82.4: So aṭṭhiṃ pātetvā sīhassa mukhato nikkhamanto daṇḍakaṃ tuṇḍena paharitvā pātentova nikkhamitvā sākhagge nilīyi.
dhpak1.13:83.1: Sīho nirogo hutvā ekadivasaṃ ekaṃ vanamahiṃsaṃ vadhitvā khādati. Sakuṇo “vīmaṃsissāmi na”nti tassa uparibhāge sākhāya
dhpak1.13:83.2: nilīyitvā tena saddhiṃ sallapanto paṭhamaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.13:84.1: 29. “Akaramhasa te kiccaṃ, yaṃ balaṃ ahuvamhase; Migarāja namo tyatthu, api kiñci labhāmase”ti.
dhpak1.13:86.1: “Mama lohitabhakkhassa, niccaṃ luddāni kubbato; Dantantaragato santo, taṃ bahuṃ yampi jīvasī”ti.
dhpak1.13:88.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto kuruṅgamigo hutvā ekasmiṃ araññāyatane phalāni khādanto vasati.
dhpak1.13:89.1: So ekasmiṃ kāle phalasampanne sepaṇṇirukkhe sepaṇṇiphalāni khādati. Atheko gāmavāsī aṭṭakaluddako phalarukkhamūlesu migānaṃ
dhpak1.13:89.2: padāni upadhāretvā uparirukkhe aṭṭakaṃ bandhitvā tattha nisīditvā phalāni khādituṃ āgatāgate mige sattiyā vijjhitvā tesaṃ
dhpak1.13:90.1: So ekadivasaṃ tasmiṃ rukkhamūle bodhisattassa padavaḷañjaṃ disvā tasmiṃ sepaṇṇirukkhe aṭṭakaṃ bandhitvā pātova bhuñjitvā
dhpak1.13:90.2: sattiṃ ādāya vanaṃ pavisitvā taṃ rukkhaṃ āruhitvā
dhpak1.13:90.3: aṭṭake nisīdi. Bodhisattopi pātova vasanaṭṭhānā nikkhamitvā “sepaṇṇiphalāni
dhpak1.13:90.4: khādissāmī”ti āgamma taṃ rukkhamūlaṃ sahasāva apavisitvā “kadāci aṭṭakaluddakā rukkhesu aṭṭakaṃ bandhanti,
dhpak1.13:90.5: atthi nu kho evarūpo upaddavo”ti pariggaṇhanto bāhiratova aṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.13:91.1: Luddakopi bodhisattassa anāgamanabhāvaṃ ñatvā aṭṭake nisinnova sepaṇṇiphalāni khipitvā khipitvā tassa purato pātesi.
dhpak1.13:91.2: Bodhisatto “imāni phalāni āgantvā mayhaṃ purato patanti, atthi nu kho upari luddako”ti punappunaṃ ullokento luddakaṃ disvā
dhpak1.13:91.3: apassanto viya hutvā “ambho, rukkha-pubbe tvaṃ olambakaṃ cārento
dhpak1.13:91.4: viya ujukameva phalāni pātesi, ajja pana te rukkhadhammo pariccatto,
dhpak1.13:91.5: evaṃ tayā rukkhadhamme pariccatte ahampi aññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ
dhpak1.13:91.6: upasaṅkamitvā mayhaṃ āhāraṃ pariyesissāmī”ti vatvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.13:92.1: 21. “Ñātametaṃ kuruṅgassa, yaṃ tvaṃ sepaṇṇi seyyasi; Aññaṃ sepaṇṇi gacchāmi, na me te ruccate phala”nti.
dhpak1.13:93.3: cā ” ti kathāsu pavattamānāsu “ na, bhikkhave,
dhpak1.13:93.4: idāneva devadatto parihīno, pubbepesa parihīnoyevā ” ti vatvā –
dhpak1.13:94.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ brahmadatte rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto rukkhadevatā hutvā nibbatti. Tadā ekasmiṃ gāmake bāḷisikā vasanti.
dhpak1.13:94.2: Atheko bāḷisiko baḷisaṃ ādāya daharena puttena saddhiṃ yasmiṃ
dhpak1.13:94.3: sobbhe pakatiyāpi bāḷisikā macche gaṇhanti, tattha gantvā baḷisaṃ khipi.
dhpak1.13:94.4: Baḷiso udakapaṭicchanne ekasmiṃ khāṇuke laggi. Bāḷisiko taṃ ākaḍḍhituṃ asakkonto cintesi “ayaṃ baḷiso mahāmacche laggo bhavissati,
dhpak1.13:94.5: puttakaṃ mātu santikaṃ pesetvā paṭivissakehi saddhiṃ kalahaṃ kārāpemi, evaṃ ito na koci koṭṭhāsaṃ paccāsīsissatī”ti.
dhpak1.13:95.1: So puttaṃ āha “gaccha, tāta, amhehi mahāmacchassa laddhabhāvaṃ mātu ācikkhāhi, ‘paṭivissakehi kira saddhiṃ kalahaṃ karohī’ti vadehī”ti.
dhpak1.13:95.2: So puttaṃ pesetvā baḷisaṃ ākaḍḍhituṃ asakkonto rajjucchedanabhayena uttarisāṭakaṃ thale ṭhapetvā udakaṃ otaritvā macchalobhena
dhpak1.13:95.3: macchaṃ upadhārento khāṇukehi paharitvā dvepi akkhīni bhindi. Thale ṭhapitasāṭakaṃpissa coro hari. So vedanāppatto hutvā
dhpak1.13:95.4: hatthena akkhīni uppīḷayamāno gahetvā udakā uttaritvā kampamāno sāṭakaṃ pariyesati.
dhpak1.13:96.1: Sāpissa bhariyā “kalahaṃ katvā kassaci apaccāsīsanabhāvaṃ karissāmī”ti ekasmiṃyeva kaṇṇe tālapaṇṇaṃ piḷandhitvā ekaṃ akkhiṃ
dhpak1.13:96.2: ukkhalimasiyā añjetvā kukkuraṃ aṅkenādāya paṭivissakagharaṃ agamāsi. Atha naṃ ekā sahāyikā evamāha “ekasmiṃyeva te kaṇṇe
dhpak1.13:96.3: tālapaṇṇaṃ piḷandhitaṃ, ekaṃ akkhi añjitaṃ, piyaputtaṃ viya kukkuraṃ aṅkenādāya gharato gharaṃ gacchasi, kiṃ ummattikāsi jātā”ti.
dhpak1.13:96.4: “Nāhaṃ ummattikā, tvaṃ pana maṃ akāraṇena akkosasi paribhāsasi, idāni taṃ gāmabhojakassa santikaṃ gantvā aṭṭha kahāpaṇe
dhpak1.13:97.1: evaṃ kalahaṃ katvā ubhopi gāmabhojakassa santikaṃ agamaṃsu. Kalahe visodhiyamāne tassāyeva matthake daṇḍo pati.
dhpak1.13:97.2: Atha naṃ bandhitvā “daṇḍaṃ dehī”ti pothetuṃ ārabhiṃsu. Rukkhadevatā gāme tassā imaṃ pavattiṃ, araññe cassā patino taṃ
dhpak1.13:97.3: byasanaṃ disvā khandhantare ṭhitā “bho purisa, tuyhaṃ udakepi
dhpak1.13:97.4: kammanto paduṭṭho thalepi, ubhatobhaṭṭho jāto”ti vatvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.13:98.1: 139. “Akkhī bhinnā paṭo naṭṭho, sakhigehe ca bhaṇḍanaṃ; Ubhato paduṭṭhā kammantā, udakamhi thalamhi cā”ti.
dhpak1.13:99.1: Evaṃ rājagahe viharantova devadattaṃ ārabbha bahūni jātakāni
dhpak1.13:99.2: kathetvā rājagahato sāvatthiṃ gantvā jetavane vihāre vāsaṃ kappesi.
dhpak1.13:100.1: Devadattopi kho nava māse gilāno pacchime kāle satthāraṃ daṭṭhukāmo
dhpak1.13:100.2: hutvā attano sāvake āha – “ ahaṃ satthāraṃ daṭṭhukāmo,
dhpak1.13:100.3: taṃ me dassethā ” ti. “ Tvaṃ samatthakāle satthārā saddhiṃ verī
dhpak1.13:100.4: hutvā acari, na mayaṃ tattha nessāmā ” ti vutte,“ mā maṃ nāsetha,
dhpak1.13:100.5: mayā satthari āghāto kato, satthu pana mayi kesaggamattopi āghāto natthi ”. So hi bhagavā –
dhpak1.13:101.1: “ Vadhake devadattamhi, core aṅgulimālake; Dhanapāle rāhule ca, sabbattha samamānaso ” ti.(apa. thera 1.1.585; mi. pa.6.6.5)–
dhpak1.13:102.1: “ Dassetha me bhagavantan ” ti punappunaṃ yāci. Atha naṃ
dhpak1.13:102.2: te mañcakenādāya nikkhamiṃsu. Tassa āgamanaṃ sutvā bhikkhū satthu ārocesuṃ –
dhpak1.13:102.3: “ bhante, devadatto kira tumhākaṃ dassanatthāya āgacchatī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:102.4: “ Na, bhikkhave, so tenattabhāvena maṃ passituṃ labhissatī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:102.5: Devadatto kira pañcannaṃ vatthūnaṃ āyācitakālato paṭṭhāya puna buddhaṃ daṭṭhuṃ na labhati, ayaṃ dhammatā.
dhpak1.13:103.1: “ Asukaṭṭhānañca asukaṭṭhānañca āgato, bhante ” ti. “ Yaṃ
dhpak1.13:103.2: icchati, taṃ karotu, na so maṃ passituṃ labhissatī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:103.3: “ Bhante, ito yojanamattaṃ āgato, aḍḍhayojanaṃ, gāvutaṃ, jetavanapokkharaṇīsamīpaṃ āgato, bhante ” ti.
dhpak1.13:103.4: “ Sacepi antojetavanaṃ pavisati, neva maṃ passituṃ labhissatī ” ti.
dhpak1.13:104.1: Devadattaṃ gahetvā āgatā jetavanapokkharaṇītīre mañcaṃ otāretvā pokkharaṇiṃ nhāyituṃ otariṃsu. Devadattopi kho mañcato
dhpak1.13:104.2: vuṭṭhāya ubho pāde bhūmiyaṃ ṭhapetvā nisīdi. Pādā pathaviṃ
dhpak1.13:104.3: pavisiṃsu. So anukkamena yāva gopphakā, yāva jaṇṇukā, yāva kaṭito,
dhpak1.13:104.4: yāva thanato, yāva gīvato pavisitvā hanukaṭṭhikassa bhūmiyaṃ paviṭṭhakāle –
dhpak1.13:105.1: “ Imehi aṭṭhīhi tamaggapuggalaṃ, Devātidevaṃ naradammasārathiṃ; Samantacakkhuṃ
dhpak1.13:105.2: satapuññalakkhaṇaṃ, Pāṇehi buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ upemī ” ti.(mi. pa.4.1.3)–
dhpak1.13:106.1: Idaṃ kira ṭhānaṃ disvā tathāgato devadattaṃ pabbājesi. Sace
dhpak1.13:106.2: hi na so pabbajissa, gihī hutvā kammañca bhāriyaṃ akarissa,
dhpak1.13:106.3: āyatiṃ bhavanissaraṇapaccayaṃ kātuṃ na sakkhissa, pabbajitvā ca pana kiñcāpi kammaṃ bhāriyaṃ karissati,
dhpak1.13:106.4: āyatiṃ bhavanissaraṇapaccayaṃ kātuṃ sakkhissatīti taṃ satthā
dhpak1.13:106.5: pabbājesi. So hi ito satasahassakappamatthake aṭṭhissaro nāma
dhpak1.13:107.1: so pathaviṃ pavisitvā avīcimhi nibbatti. Niccale buddhe
dhpak1.13:107.2: aparajjhabhāvena pana niccalova hutvā paccatūti yojanasatike anto
dhpak1.13:107.3: avīcimhi yojanasatubbedhamevassa sarīraṃ nibbatti. Sīsaṃ yāva
dhpak1.13:107.4: kaṇṇasakkhalito upari ayakapallaṃ pāvisi, pādā yāva gopphakā
dhpak1.13:107.5: heṭṭhā ayapathaviyaṃ paviṭṭhā, mahātālakkhandhaparimāṇaṃ ayasūlaṃ pacchimabhittito nikkhamitvā piṭṭhimajjhaṃ bhinditvā
dhpak1.13:107.7: dakkhiṇabhittito nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇapassaṃ bhinditvā vāmapassena nikkhamitvā
dhpak1.13:107.8: uttarabhittiṃ pāvisi, aparaṃ upari kapallato nikkhamitvā matthakaṃ bhinditvā adhobhāgena nikkhamitvā ayapathaviṃ pāvisi.
dhpak1.13:108.1: Bhikkhū “ ettakaṃ ṭhānaṃ devadatto āgacchanto satthāraṃ
dhpak1.13:109.1: Satthā “ na, bhikkhave, devadatto idāneva mayi aparajjhitvā
dhpak1.13:109.2: pathaviṃ pāvisi, pubbepi paviṭṭhoyevā ” ti vatvā hatthirājakāle
dhpak1.13:109.3: maggamūḷhaṃ purisaṃ samassāsetvā attano piṭṭhiṃ āropetvā
dhpak1.13:109.4: khemantaṃ pāpitassa puna tikkhattuṃ āgantvā aggaṭṭhāne majjhimaṭṭhāne
dhpak1.13:109.5: mūlehi evaṃ dante chinditvā tatiyavāre mahāpurisassa cakkhupathaṃ atikkamantassa tassa pathaviṃ paviṭṭhabhāvaṃ dīpetuṃ –
dhpak1.13:110.1: 72. “Akataññussa posassa, niccaṃ vivaradassino; Sabbaṃ ce pathaviṃ dajjā, neva naṃ abhirādhaye”ti.
dhpak1.13:111.1: Idaṃ jātakaṃ kathetvā punapi tatheva kathāya
dhpak1.13:111.2: samuṭṭhitāya khantivādibhūte attani aparajjhitvā kalāburājabhūtassa tassa
dhpak1.13:112.1: cūḷadhammapālabhūte attani aparajjhitvā mahāpatāparājabhūtassa tassa pathaviṃ
dhpak1.13:113.1: Pathaviṃ paviṭṭhe pana devadatte mahājano haṭṭhatuṭṭho dhajapaṭākakadaliyo ussāpetvā puṇṇaghaṭe
dhpak1.13:113.2: ṭhapetvā “ lābhā vata no ” ti mahantaṃ chaṇaṃ anubhoti.
dhpak1.13:114.1: Tamatthaṃ bhagavato ārocesuṃ. Bhagavā “ na, bhikkhave, idāneva
dhpak1.13:114.2: devadatte mate mahājano tussati, pubbepi tussiyevā ” ti
dhpak1.13:114.3: vatvā sabbajanassa appiye caṇḍe pharuse bārāṇasiyaṃ
dhpak1.13:114.4: piṅgalaraññe nāma mate mahājanassa tuṭṭhabhāvaṃ dīpetuṃ –
dhpak1.13:115.1: Atīte bārāṇasiyaṃ mahāpiṅgalo nāma rājā adhammena visamena rajjaṃ kāresi, chandādivasena pāpakammāni karonto
dhpak1.13:115.2: daṇḍabalijaṅghakahāpaṇādiggahaṇena ucchuyante ucchuṃ viya mahājanaṃ pīḷesi kakkhaḷo pharuso sāhasiko,
dhpak1.13:115.5: akkhimhi patitarajaṃ viya, bhattapiṇḍe sakkharā viya, paṇhiṃ vijjhitvā paviṭṭhakaṇṭako viya ca ahosi.
dhpak1.13:116.1: Tadā bodhisatto mahāpiṅgalassa putto hutvā nibbatti. Mahāpiṅgalo dīgharattaṃ rajjaṃ kāretvā kālamakāsi.
dhpak1.13:116.2: Tasmiṃ kālakate sakalabārāṇasivāsino haṭṭhatuṭṭhā mahāhasitaṃ hasitvā dārūnaṃ sakaṭasahassena mahāpiṅgalaṃ jhāpetvā anekehi
dhpak1.13:116.3: ghaṭasahassehi āḷāhanaṃ nibbāpetvā bodhisattaṃ rajje abhisiñcitvā
dhpak1.13:116.4: “dhammiko no rājā laddho”ti haṭṭhatuṭṭhā nagare ussavabheriṃ
dhpak1.13:116.5: carāpetvā samussitadhajapaṭākaṃ nagaraṃ alaṅkaritvā dvāre dvāre maṇḍapaṃ kāretvā vippakiṇṇalājakusumamaṇḍitatalesu
dhpak1.13:116.7: ca. Bodhisattopi alaṅkate mahātale samussitasetacchattassa pallaṅkavarassa
dhpak1.13:116.8: majjhe mahāyasaṃ anubhavanto nisīdi. Amaccā ca brāhmaṇagahapatiraṭṭhikadovārikādayo ca rājānaṃ parivāretvā aṭṭhaṃsu.
dhpak1.13:117.1: Atheko dovāriko nātidūre ṭhatvā assasanto passasanto parodi. Bodhisatto taṃ disvā “samma dovārika, mama pitari kālakate
dhpak1.13:117.2: sabbe tuṭṭhapahaṭṭhā ussavaṃ kīḷantā vicaranti, tvaṃ pana rodamāno ṭhito, kiṃ nu kho mama pitā taveva piyo ahosi manāpo”ti
dhpak1.13:118.3: Piyo nu te āsi akaṇhanetto, kasmā nu tvaṃ rodasi dvārapālā”ti.
dhpak1.13:119.1: So tassa vacanaṃ sutvā “nāhaṃ, mahārāja, ‘mahāpiṅgalo mato’ti sokena rodāmi, sīsassa me sukhaṃ jātaṃ.
dhpak1.13:119.2: Piṅgalarājā hi pāsādā otaranto ca ārohanto ca kammāramuṭṭhikāya paharanto viya mayhaṃ sīse aṭṭhaṭṭha khaṭake deti,
dhpak1.13:119.3: so paralokaṃ gantvāpi mama sīse dadamāno viya nirayapālānampi yamassapi sīle khaṭake dassati, atha naṃ te ‘ativiya ayaṃ
dhpak1.13:119.4: amhe bādhatī’ti puna idheva ānetvā vissajjeyyuṃ, atha me
dhpak1.13:119.5: so punapi sīse khaṭake dadeyyāti bhayenāhaṃ rodāmī”ti imamatthaṃ
dhpak1.13:120.1: 180. “Na me piyo āsi akaṇhanetto, bhāyāmi paccāgamanāya tassa;
dhpak1.13:120.2: Ito gato hiṃseyya maccurājaṃ, so hiṃsito āneyya puna idhā”ti.
dhpak1.13:121.1: Bhikkhū satthāraṃ pucchiṃsu – “ idāni, bhante, devadatto kuhiṃ nibbatto ” ti? “ Avīcimahāniraye, bhikkhave ” ti.
dhpak1.13:121.2: “ Bhante, idha tappanto vicaritvā puna gantvā tappanaṭṭhāneyeva nibbatto
dhpak1.13:121.3: ” ti. “ Āma, bhikkhave, pabbajitā vā hontu gahaṭṭhā vā,
dhpak1.13:121.4: pamādavihārino ubhayattha tappantiyevā ” ti vatvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.13:122.1: 17. “ Idha tappati pecca tappati, pāpakārī ubhayattha tappati; Pāpaṃ me katanti tappati, bhiyyo tappati duggatiṃ gato ” ti.
dhpak1.13:123.1: 17. “ Idha tappati pecca tappati, pāpakārī ubhayattha tappati;
dhpak1.13:123.2: Pāpaṃ me katanti tappati, bhiyyo tappati duggatiṃ gato ” ti.
dhpak1.13:124.1: Gāthāpariyosāne bahū sotāpannādayo ahesuṃ. Desanā mahājanassa sātthikā jātāti.
